metadata.title: Strategy Stock In Worst Losing Streak Since Late 2022 as Bitcoin Dips Under $60,000<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Strategy Stock Mired In Worst Losing Streak Since Late 2022 as Bitcoin Under $60,000
As Bitcoin hovered below $60,000 on Friday, the world’s largest corporate holder of the cryptocurrency was weathering its own tailspin.
